03_distance_all.name: 03_distance_all
03_distance_all.caption: Frozen expanded_A. Display-only simultaneous 3-sigma selection on reference x and predicted y distances in linear kpc: arithmetic mean +/- 3 population standard deviations (ddof=0), one pass, independently for each population/reference pair. All three panels use the same retained objects. Narrow attached residual axis is linear from -100% to 100%; its x-axis is shared with the main distance panel. Central histogram uses 2 percentage-point bins. Out-of-window and sigma-exclusion counts are retained in CSV/JSON. Trend bars are P16-P84 object spread, not median confidence intervals. Original uncut scientific metrics and anomaly audit remain unchanged. Reference-source samples overlap.

03_distance_all.sparse: gray crosses indicate 1–19 objects; empty cells are transparent
03_distance_all.count_source: Per-object eligible/finite/plotted in panels; per-bin or paired N in linked CSV.
03_distance_all.distance_layout: main + attached residual (height ratio 4:1) + central histogram
